research_digest_decisions.reason: The source scan supplies a distinct physical-capacity mechanism and explicit counterevidence; it is retained only as a lead until a market prior and PIT event surface are bound.

hypothesis_candidates.baseline: Static AI-power/grid theme membership or same-sector peer exposure.
hypothesis_candidates.treatment: A source-dated comparable backlog/book-to-bill increase combined with delayed lead-time or capacity relief, scored only after an observable pre-event expectation surface is available.
hypothesis_candidates.replacement_value_comparator: Cash, SPY, QQQ, static theme peers and the exact cash-feasible core candidate displaced.
hypothesis_candidates.falsifier: No normalized PIT series, fewer than five touches per canonical window, lead times below 12 months for two quarters, supply growth overtakes demand/backlog, or no incremental information beyond revisions and price.

hypothesis_candidates.treatment: A source-dated change in qualified EUV/optics capacity or tool acceptance relative to observable bookings and consensus.
hypothesis_candidates.falsifier: Public capacity and qualification observables remain proprietary or cannot be separated from already-priced bookings.

hypothesis_candidates.treatment: A source-dated qualification or trusted-packaging capacity inflection relative to contract expectations.
hypothesis_candidates.expected_horizon: contract or qualification event through H20
hypothesis_candidates.falsifier: No concentrated supplier node, no public qualification-duration series, or issuer filings continue to state capacity is adequate.

economic_mechanism: Customized transformer and switchgear capacity expands slowly, but equity alpha can exist only when source-dated backlog or delivery relief changes faster than the observable market prior.
falsifier: The selected mechanism is rejected as an alpha candidate if it reduces to static theme membership, lacks an authorized PIT event surface, has fewer than five executable touches per canonical window, or adds no replacement value beyond observable revisions and price.
next_machine_action: Run the source-authorization, PIT archive and candidate-density contract for issuer backlog/capacity releases; do not reserve an experiment ID or change production policy.
